description: Defines the HistoryEntry class for managing history records of NoteContent payloads, including delta calculations and comparison methods.

classes.name: HistoryEntry
classes.description: Represents a history record for a NoteContent payload, capable of computing deltas, comparing entries, and determining operation vectors.

methods.name: itemFromPayload
methods.description: Creates a DecryptedItemInterface from the current payload.

methods.name: isSameAsEntry
methods.description: Checks if this history entry is the same as another based on payload content and modification date.

methods.name: isDiscardable
methods.description: Indicates whether the history entry can be discarded (always false in this class).

methods.name: operationVector
methods.description: Determines the direction of change: 0 (no change), -1 (deletion), 1 (addition).

methods.name: deltaSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the change in characters based on the delta.
